# NAMS response fixtures

Shapes observed by the live probe on 2026-10-04 (`spikes/critic-loop/probe-generate.ts`, one throwaway workspace, three faithful-world
stone_pickaxe runs, prose format). Values are invented; only the keys, types and status words are real.
`run-failed-assumed.json` is the one shape not observed: a failed run was not provoked, so its `failCode` and scores are assumed
from the same record and need a real failure to confirm.
